instruction: Please change the volume slider color to a reddish tone. I prefer warmer colors in my interface, and a red-based slider would match my desktop theme better.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
